paper: A Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Rendering of Very Large Datasets

mipnerf360.source: Section 6.2 text (evaluation.tex:170-171), 'average over the entire dataset'; no per-scene, SSIM or LPIPS, no stated scene set/resolution/PSNR variant

protocol_notes.resolution: official default: full-res images capped at 1600 px width -> our dataset mipnerf360-1600; tau in px at render resolution
protocol_notes.scene_set: their 3DGS 29.11 is not reachable as a 9-scene llffhold8 mean (our 9-scene gsplat ~27.2-27.3) but fits the 7 original public scenes (no flowers/treehill: our 7-scene 28.81 at images_4/2, 3DGS paper 28.69) -> compare leaves-3DGS on the 7-scene mean; also report 9-scene
protocol_notes.psnr_variant: official render_hierarchy.py averages per-channel PSNR (utils/image_utils.psnr on [3,H,W]); >= full-image PSNR (Jensen) -> report both
protocol_notes.finest_row: official render_hierarchy default taus [0,3,6,15]: tau=0 is a 1 px threshold; 'leaves' = all leaves (our tau -0.5, threshold 0)

smallcity_chunk.source: Table 1 (tab:comparisons); chunk not identified; also Wayve/Campus/BigCity columns (data not released)

notes: Only the Mip-NeRF 360 numbers are on data we have. Their 3DGS (29.11) is the authors' own run (3DGS paper 9-scene 27.21, 7-scene 28.69) and most likely a 7-scene mean with per-channel PSNR. Primary comparisons: tau deltas (scene-set independent) opt tau3/6/15 - leaves = -0.09/-0.44/-1.71, basic tau3/6/15 - leaves = -0.10/-0.91/-4.14; leaves - 3DGS = -0.15 on the 7-scene mean. Wayve no-interpolation ablation: 25.21/24.73/23.44.
